{"metadata":{"description":"Enhanced model picker for the dsh web GUI — replaces the composer's model seat","id":"gh:1367947272","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-model-picker","slug":"ttmouse/dsh-model-picker","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Enhanced model picker for the dsh web GUI — replaces the composer's model seat"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# dsh-model-picker"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Enhanced model picker for the dsh web GUI — replaces the composer's model seat
(`conversation.input."},{"id":"p4s2","text":" model picker for the dsh web GUI — replaces the composer's model seat
(`conversation.input.model`)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Design"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A **two-zone trigger button** splits model selection and reasoning-effort
selection into separate po"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"wo-zone trigger button** splits model selection and reasoning-effort
selection into separate popups:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Zone | Click | Popup content |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| **Left** (model name) | Opens the model picker | Search box at top (auto-focused), provider column"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" on the left, model list on the right |
| **Right** (effort) | Opens the effort picker | List of ava"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ilable reasoning-effort levels |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Hovering a zone names what it will act on. The model zone reads
`provider · model`: one model id is "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"routinely served by several providers, so
the name alone does not say where the model runs. The supp"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"lier named is the
**display** one, so a selection on a folded `(modlens vision)` route still reads
a"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"s its base provider — the same name the user clicked in the column."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The panel is 540px wide and up to 500px tall, and both give way under pressure
rather than overflowi"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ng. Its height is clamped against the measured space above
the trigger (which is `50vh + 61px` in th"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"e hero layout, checked at six window
heights), minus the panel's own chrome: at a 900px-tall window "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"the panel measures
exactly 500px and keeps an 11px margin from the top edge. When the provider
colum"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"n folds, the panel gives up that column's width instead of stretching the
model list (see **Configur"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"e official models**)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Supplier chip"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"A model row leads with the **mark of whoever made the model** — DeepSeek's whale,
Zhipu's mark, Qwen"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"'s — on the **closed trigger** as well as on every row in the
list, so which model is in use, and wh"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ose it is, reads before the picker is ever
opened. Marks are the published mono cuts from
`@lobehub/"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"icons-static-svg` (MIT),
inlined as paths on their own 24×24 grid and filled with `currentColor`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- The mark names the **model's maker**, not the supplier: `17an-mumiao`,
`qwen-token-plan-cn` and `o"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"pencode-go1` all serve `deepseek-v4-flash`, and the
question a row answers is "what am I picking". A"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" per-supplier mark would answer
"who resells it" and, worse, could only ever be a letter for the thr"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ee `17an`
floors.
- **Two rules, lab first.** The model's own lab is read from the leading token of
"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"any `vendor/model`, `vendor:model` or `vendor_model` segment — that is what
catches `17an-db/deepsee"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"k-v4.1-flash`. Only when no lab is named does the
**host** in the label earn a mark, matched as a wh"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"ole word, so `Composer 2.5 ·
Cursor` and `Auto · Cursor` wear Cursor's.
- The order between them is "},{"id":"p13s8","text":"the whole design: `grok-4.7@500k · Cursor` is Grok's
model resold **through** Cursor, and `DeepSeek-"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"V4.1-Flash · Trae CN` is
DeepSeek's through Trae. Reading the host first would relabel both with the"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"
wrong maker — exactly the mistake a mark exists to prevent — so a host mark
only ever appears on a "},{"id":"p13s11","text":"row whose model segment named no lab at all.
- A row whose maker cannot be named honestly — `Auto · "},{"id":"p13s12","text":"routing group`,
`Space-Bunny`, `Ling 3.1 Flash Free` — keeps the **supplier's tinted initial**
inste"},{"id":"p13s13","text":"ad. The two shapes say different things at a glance: a mark is a lab, a
tinted uppercase letter is ""},{"id":"p13s14","text":"the picker cannot name this row's maker yet". A
mislabelled logo would be worse than a letter the pa"},{"id":"p13s15","text":"nel can always back up.
- The fallback letter is matched by a **fixed prefix list**, deliberately no"},{"id":"p13s16","text":"t a
generic "first word" rule: `mimo` and `hy3` are real families whose ids carry
no lab in them, so"},{"id":"p13s17","text":" they are listed by name, while a rule loose enough to guess
them would also hand `auto` a logo it h"},{"id":"p13s18","text":"as not earned.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Provider folding"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"A provider whose name is another provider's name plus a trailing parenthesized
capability suffix fol"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ds into that base provider's row. modlens registers vision
as its own provider route (`DeepSeek (mod"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"lens vision)`), which would otherwise
put a near-duplicate row per provider in the column."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- Folding is **display-only**: every row keeps its models paired with the group
that serves them, so"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" picking a folded model still submits that model's own
provider id.
- The suffix stays on the model "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"name, and a folded model whose route differs
from its row is labelled with that route, so the two ar"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"e never confused.
- A suffixed provider whose base is absent keeps its own row."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Model facts (context window / image input)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The browser catalog the seat reads (`ModelCatalogModel`) carries only
`id / name / description / rea"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"soning` — **no** context window and **no** input
modalities. Both exist on the Host's `llm` service,"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" so the host half
(`lib/host.js`) republishes them over one loopback route:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `resolveModel()` is the only source of `context: { contextWindow }`;
`listModels()` is the cheaper"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" source of `inputModalities`.
- One row per provider/model is isolated: a provider or model that thr"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ows is
dropped, and a row carrying neither fact is omitted entirely.
- The snapshot is cached for 30"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"s — the route never fans out per keystroke.
- The popup badges each row with an image glyph, which r"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"ides **after the model
name** because input modality is a property of the model, and with a context
"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"chip (`1M`, `384K`) in the trailing strip, where the numbers line up as a
column you can compare dow"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"n. Both are joined on `provider/modelId`.
- **Vision.** A plain glyph means the model reads pixels i"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"tself. A glyph with a
slash across it means the route accepts images only because modlens bridges
th"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"em: the model still cannot see — modlens transcribes the image to text
first. The `(modlens vision)`"},{"id":"p20s10","text":" suffix is what tells the two apart.
- The slash, rather than a dimmed glyph, is deliberate. Fading "},{"id":"p20s11","text":"the glyph to
carry "this model cannot see" put it under the 3:1 floor for non-text
graphics and eras"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"ed the distinction entirely in greyscale. A shape difference
survives low vision, greyscale and both"},{"id":"p20s13","text":" themes; a lighter grey does not.
- The modlens suffix is *not* the general vision signal: modlens d"},{"id":"p20s14","text":"eclines to
wrap a model whose id already carries a vision marker, whose catalog
declares image input"},{"id":"p20s15","text":", or that falls outside its configured families. A row
with no suffix can therefore be natively visi"},{"id":"p20s16","text":"on-capable; the glyph, not the
name, is the answer. With modlens disabled the folding and the bridge"},{"id":"p20s17","text":" glyph
are simply dormant — nothing is suffixed.
- Before the host half has been restarted the route"},{"id":"p20s18","text":" 404s, so the context chip
and native-vision glyph are missing until then."}],"truncated":true}
